claim: The CLI and /demo use bundled sample data without changing real data.
where: landing sample action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh temporary directory and demo browser context; verify realistic loss output, report files, and temporary output path

claim: The documented cargo install command installs a working public MIT-licensed artifact.
sandbox: fresh CARGO_HOME and install root; install from the public Git repository and run --help

claim: CLI scans do not modify source files.
sandbox: copied sample export; compare source hash and modification time before and after a real scan

claim: Browser sample names, contents, and results are not uploaded or saved.
where: landing facts, demo banner, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; record the whole demo flow request log and inspect local and session storage

claim: The site has no analytics, advertising cookies, tracking pixels, or third-party scripts.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record initial requests, cookies, and local storage

claim: Reports include notebook, note, attachment, and attachment-byte counts, and browser reports download as JSON.
sandbox: bundled sample in CLI and browser; assert exact counts and a JSON download

claim: Reports include link targets, metadata coverage, and conversion risks.
sandbox: bundled sample with dated metadata, tags, links, tasks, a table, code, a wiki link, and audio

claim: The CLI scans directories and ZIP archives.
sandbox: scan the same bundled sample as a directory and a ZIP; compare totals

claim: The CLI recognizes Markdown, HTML, text, RTF, ENEX, and JSON note files.
sandbox: fresh directory containing one valid note in every named format

claim: ZIP entries are scanned without extraction and unsafe paths and configured boundaries are rejected.
sandbox: malicious traversal ZIP plus a valid ZIP above a one-entry limit; assert errors and no extracted file

claim: The CLI writes schema 2 JSON and reads schema 1 reports.
sandbox: write a real schema 2 report, convert it to the prior shape, and read it through the CLI

claim: Saved reports omit note bodies and attachment bytes.
sandbox: fresh files with unique private markers; scan to JSON and assert the markers are absent

claim: Comparison finds missing or changed notes and missing attachments.
sandbox: bundled before-and-after sample; assert one changed note, one missing attachment, and loss verdict

claim: Duplicate names and equal-size different attachments cannot hide loss.
sandbox: two same-titled notes and equal-size attachment names against one surviving copy

claim: The CLI exits 0 after success, 1 for invalid input, and 2 when fail-on-loss detects loss.
sandbox: run valid scan, missing input, and lossy comparison as independent processes

claim: Proprietary database exports are reported as unsupported without an encryption bypass.
sandbox: fresh SQLite-named fixture; assert zero decoded notes and the unsupported warning

claim: The browser demo reloads and inspects its folder sample offline after the first visit.
sandbox: own fresh browser context; wait for service-worker control, set context offline, reload, and assert populated output

claim: Preflight Plus costs $19 once and is not a subscription.
where: landing first screen, Plus section, terms, README
sandbox: fresh browser; assert the exact offer and the product billing checkout target

claim: A valid license enables browser comparison, a saved baseline, a printable audit, and a setup-support path.
sandbox: recorded valid verification fixture; scan, persist and reload a baseline, invoke print, and verify support path

claim: License verification sends only the token at most once per day and invalid licenses stay locked.
sandbox: recorded invalid verification fixture; inspect method, query, body, reload frequency, and locked state
